 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PURNENDU SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 05-02-2026 Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners and learned AC to Standing Counsel (8) for the State.
2. The petitioners in paragraph no. 1 of the present writ petition have sought, inter alia, the following relief(s), which is reproduced hereinafter:-
"1.

That the petitioner has approached this Hon'ble Court by invoking its Extra- Ordinary Writ Jurisdiction as enshrined under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, for following relief(s):
i.

For issuance of writ in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondent authorities to make payment of fair compensation along with interest against acquisition of the petitioner's land situated under Mauja- Dumari Bujurg, Thana No.
22, Thana- Sonpur, Circle Sonpur, District Saran for construction of SSB headquarter in terms of the publication issued vide PR 15320 (Revenue) 2019-20 by the District Magistrate, Saran, Chapra.

ii. For issuance of writ of mandamus directing the Respondent authorities to complete the issuance of payment notice under Section 37(2) of the Right to Fair Md. Karimuddin Ansari vs The State Of Bihar on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118810164/
1 Compensation and Patna High Court CWJC No.1799 of 2026(2) dt.05-02-2026 Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred as RFCTLARR Act, 2013) including the interest thereon.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
iii. For any other relief(s) that this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and appropriate."
3.

Considering the relief(s), as sought for in the present writ petition, the Land Acquisition Officer,
Saran, Chapra is directed to go to the house of the petitioners and get all the requisite forms filled and make payment of the amount of due compensation, well within a period of two weeks.
4. Re-notify on 17.02.2026, at the top of the list, along with the compliance report.

(Purnendu Singh, J) Ashishsingh/-
